changelog:
v2.7.3 — 🔔 FIREBASE PUSH ENGINE

The wake-up bell is wired into the Empire.

• Your phone can now be reached even when the Empire is fully closed — the same mechanism WhatsApp uses to ring your phone for calls.
• Incoming call ringing (for Empire Talk), Guardian alerts, and group alerts arrive as high-priority notifications.
• APK grew slightly — that's the push engine (Firebase messaging).
• Next: the server side arms (via the Firebase service-account key), then Empire Talk voice + video + chat with recording.
